experiment.name: Pricing headline
experiment.hypothesis: Leading with the annual price gets more visitors to pick a plan than leading with the monthly price.

verdict.reason: annual_first is at 64.5% and its interval (-33.4% to +49.0%) crosses zero. Inconclusive; do not call it.

checks.name: Sample ratio
checks.detail: p = 0.356 from Last Call's chi-square cross-check (Flagsmith returned null); warn below 0.001

checks.name: Minimum sample
checks.detail: every arm has at least 50 identities and 5 conversions

checks.name: Chance to beat control
checks.detail: annual_first: 64.5%; winning at 95% or more, losing at 5% or less

plain: We tested whether leading with the annual price gets more visitors to pick the plan than leading with the monthly price. The decision is to keep running because annual first is at 64.5% and its interval (-33.4% to +49.0%) crosses zero.
